name: Y2Kbench
about: Windows XP tasks for measuring how well an agent drives the XP machine. Every task starts on a fresh machine with an empty C:\work folder. Checks run inside XP after the agent finishes (via a batch file on the shared drive) or look at the agent's reply.

tasks.title: Create a text file
tasks.prompt: Create a text file at C:\work\hello.txt containing exactly this text: Hello from Y2Kbot

checks.label: file has the text
checks.probe: type C:\work\hello.txt

tasks.title: Create a folder
tasks.prompt: Create a new folder called reports inside C:\work.

checks.label: folder exists
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\reports\NUL (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

tasks.title: Rename a file
tasks.prompt: Rename the file C:\work\draft.txt to final.txt (keep it in the same folder).

checks.label: final.txt exists
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\final.txt (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

checks.label: draft.txt is gone
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\draft.txt (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

tasks.title: Rename a folder
tasks.prompt: Rename the folder C:\work\old_projects to archive_2003.

checks.label: new name exists
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\archive_2003\NUL (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

checks.label: old name is gone
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\old_projects\NUL (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

checks.label: contents kept
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\archive_2003\notes.txt (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

tasks.title: Delete one file
tasks.prompt: Delete the file C:\work\junk.txt. Leave every other file alone.

checks.label: junk.txt deleted
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\junk.txt (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

checks.label: keep.txt untouched
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\keep.txt (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

tasks.title: Move a file
tasks.prompt: Move invoice.txt from the folder C:\work\inbox into the folder C:\work\done.

checks.label: in done
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\done\invoice.txt (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

checks.label: not in inbox
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\inbox\invoice.txt (echo FOUND) else (echo MISSING)

tasks.title: Use Calculator
tasks.prompt: Use the Windows Calculator on the XP machine to work out 1234 multiplied by 5678, then tell me the answer.

tasks.title: Find the computer name
tasks.prompt: What is the name of this XP computer? Find it on the machine and tell me exactly.

checks.label: reply has the real name
checks.probe: echo %COMPUTERNAME%

tasks.title: Write a multi-line file
tasks.prompt: Create C:\work\fruit.txt with three lines, in this order: apple, banana, cherry (one word per line, nothing else).

checks.label: three lines in order
checks.probe: type C:\work\fruit.txt

tasks.title: Add a line to a file
tasks.prompt: Open C:\work\shopping.txt and add a new last line that says: milk. Keep the existing lines exactly as they are, and save it.

checks.label: old lines kept, milk added last
checks.probe: type C:\work\shopping.txt

tasks.title: Find and replace in a file
tasks.prompt: In the file C:\work\pets.txt, change every 'cat' to 'dog', then save the file.

checks.label: words replaced
checks.probe: type C:\work\pets.txt

expect.contains: The dog sat next to the dog flap.

xp: echo The cat sat next to the cat flap.> C:\work\pets.txt

tasks.title: Copy a file to the shared drive
tasks.prompt: Copy C:\work\report.txt onto the shared drive ({{share}}) so that I can pick it up.

tasks.title: Read a file from the shared drive
tasks.prompt: There's a file called input.txt on the shared drive. Open it on the XP machine and tell me the secret word written inside.

tasks.title: Save a WordPad document
tasks.prompt: Use WordPad to write a document containing this sentence: Dear Sir, thank you for your letter. Save it as C:\work\letter.rtf

checks.label: letter.rtf has the sentence
checks.probe: type C:\work\letter.rtf

tasks.title: Save a Paint picture
tasks.prompt: Open Paint, draw anything you like, and save the picture as C:\work\drawing.bmp

checks.label: drawing.bmp saved
checks.probe: if exist C:\work\drawing.bmp (for %%F in (C:\work\drawing.bmp) do echo SIZE %%~zF) else (echo MISSING)

tasks.title: Extract a zip file
tasks.prompt: Extract all the files from {{share}}\archive.zip into a new folder C:\work\unzipped.

checks.label: readme.txt extracted
checks.probe: dir /s /b C:\work\unzipped

tasks.title: Run an installer
tasks.prompt: There's an installer on the shared drive called install.vbs. Run it and install 'Y2K Demo' to its default folder, accepting the licence.

checks.label: Y2K Demo installed
checks.probe: type "C:\Program Files\Y2K Demo\installed.txt"

tasks.title: Make a desktop shortcut
tasks.prompt: Put a shortcut to Notepad on the desktop.

checks.label: a desktop shortcut points at Notepad
checks.probe: findstr /i /m notepad "%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\*.lnk"

tasks.title: Show file extensions
tasks.prompt: Change the folder options so that file extensions (like .txt) are shown for all files.

checks.label: HideFileExt is 0
checks.probe: reg query "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v HideFileExt

tasks.title: Change the screen saver
tasks.prompt: Set the screen saver to 3D Pipes.

checks.label: screen saver is 3D Pipes
checks.probe: reg query "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v SCRNSAVE.EXE

tasks.title: Change the wallpaper
tasks.prompt: Change the desktop background to the built-in picture called Azul.

checks.label: background is Azul
checks.probe: (reg query "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Desktop\General" /v WallpaperSource & reg query "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v Wallpaper)
